column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.75.
# THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE. CM051 VENDORS IT.
# CM051 scripts/sync_cut_bom.sh copies this file into cuts/v1.0.75/ there and
# records the OS003 commit it came from in cuts/BOM_PIN.
# EVERY ROW SAYS ONE OF THREE THINGS AND NEVER A FOURTH
#   gate:<workflow>#<what>  a CI gate that FAILS on the real pre-fix tree
#   artefact:<sha8>#<what>  measured on the published artefact itself
#   needs-walk:<ver>#<what> UNPROVEN, and here is exactly what to look at
# WHY THIS CUT EXISTS, IN ONE LINE
# v1.0.75 IS THE CUT THAT CAN INSTALL. v1.0.73 aborted at step 5 of 41 on
# every fresh install; this one completed all 41 steps with no errors raised.
# HOW THE ROWS WERE SELECTED, AND WHAT WAS LEFT OUT
# 8 commits landed on CM051 main between the v1.0.73 artefact (c0401242) and
# this cut. The predicate is the same one v1.0.73 used: the commit touches a
# path that reaches the customer -- install.sh, gui/, vendor/ or
# assistant-agent/. THREE did. Two carry rows; both are install.sh.
# TWO OF THE THREE ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT, with the measurement rather than
# the assertion:
#   ab286995 (#1751) touches vendor/VENDOR_MANIFEST.toml and NOTHING ELSE in
#   the vendored file-set. It is a hold_ack, not a re-pin:
#       git show ab286995 -- vendor/VENDOR_MANIFEST.toml \
#         | grep -cE '^[+-][[:space:]]*pinned_sha[[:space:]]*='     -> 0
#   with a positive control proving that pattern matches a real pin line. No
#   pinned_sha moved, so no vendored byte changed, so the artefact is
#   unaffected and a row asserting otherwise would be false.
#   e799a34a (#1748) touches gui/Makefile only. The Makefile builds the DMG
#   and is not IN the DMG, so no capability pattern could ever find it in the
#   artefact.
# EVERY PATTERN BEHIND A capability_id WAS RUN AGAINST BOTH REFS
# A capability whose pattern also matches at v1.0.73 measures nothing: it
# would go green on the PREVIOUS artefact, so it cannot notice this cut's
# payload going missing. Each was checked at c0401242 (must be 0) and at the
# v1.0.75 tree (must be non-zero), with two controls:
#     ollama_agent_check_is_guarded                    0      1
#     credential_generation_has_no_sigpipe             0      1
#     port_preflight_status_is_read_not_fatal          0      1
#     runtime_ready_status_is_read_not_fatal           0      1
#     CONTROL present in both refs                     5      6   <- must NOT discriminate
#     CONTROL present in neither                       0      0   <- must be broken
# MY FIRST TWO PATTERNS FOR TNM'S SITES WERE GUESSED AND BOTH FAILED THIS
# TABLE -- one scored 0/0 and one scored 1/5, i.e. it already matched the
# artefact it was meant to discriminate against. They were re-derived from the
# added lines of 27236c3d. That is why the table is here rather than a claim.
what

THE ASSISTANT COULD NOT ANSWER FROM THE CUSTOMER'S OWN FACTS. render_person in crates/zeroclaw-tools/src/pwg_people.rs projected name/organisation/title/last_contact/identifiers/wiki_url and NEVER read the facts array, so a person whose employer /people/context and /api/v1/people/{slug}/enrichment BOTH returned verbatim produced 'it does not explicitly state where she works'. The model reported its payload accurately; the payload was stripped at the tool boundary. Established with a control: extracting only field LABELS for a person WITH enrichment gave Name/Organisation/Wiki, so there was no facts field for anybody. Ships via signed hub-v0.4.74, sha e93e4f01.

THE ASSISTANT CITED ITS OWN PRIOR NON-ANSWERS AS EVIDENCE. consolidation.rs Phase 1 wrote history_entry to MemoryCategory::Daily on EVERY turn unconditionally, while Phase 2 three lines below already guarded Core with a non-empty check. Measured on the v1.0.74 box: 4 of the 5 memories recalled for a person were records of the assistant's OWN earlier non-answers, top-ranked at 86 percent, and it answered from those instead of querying the graph. Self-reinforcing: each retelling wrote another copy. Ships via signed hub-v0.4.74.

DAEMON PIN. install.sh and gui/Makefile move to the signed, notarised, stapled hub-v0.4.74 (sha e93e4f01), in FIVE places -- OSTLER_ASSISTANT_VERSION, DEFAULT_ASSISTANT_TARBALL_SHA256, DAEMON_VERSION, DAEMON_SHA256 and cut.env DAEMON_COMMIT. The fifth was found by the supply-chain gate failing closed, the same class as HR015 #583 where a retry re-pointed the URLs and left the baked pin behind. Proven by make download-daemon rc=0 fetching and hash-verifying the PUBLISHED asset.

INSTALL FLOOR. install.sh refuses below macOS 14 with ERR-02-PREREQ-MACOS-OLD, and README states the floors -- macOS 14, 35 GB recommended, 15 GB hard. The PREREQ prefix matters beyond the message: walk_drive.py classifies a bracketed ERR-NN-PREREQ-* as a BOX PRECONDITION and returns CANNOT-RUN, so a machine that fails the floor no longer reads as a product abort.

FULL DISK ACCESS DRAG-IN. The modal names the assistant bundle path a human can actually reach, derived from ASSISTANT_APP_BUNDLE rather than hard-coded, puts it on the clipboard and says so ONLY when pbcopy exited 0, and points at a Finder window ONLY when open -R actually opened one.
